note: Each contract has a stable ID. Pester It blocks claim a contract with -Tag 'Contract:<ID>'; cases that need the pinned Python reference also carry the 'Reference' tag. Contracts with no tagged case are reported as Not covered. Add rows as the source inventory in docs/compatibility-contracts.md is converted into testable contracts.

contracts.title: Cryptographic addressing: derive the expected destination address from a fixed identity and application name
contracts.boundary: One deterministic identity/name fixture; not a statistical uniqueness proof.

contracts.title: Cryptographic communication: produce Ed25519 signatures and decrypt authenticated identity ciphertext matching independent fixtures
contracts.boundary: Fixture-level functionality, not a cryptographic audit or complete forward-secrecy acceptance.

contracts.title: Delivery confirmations: probe an actual Python proof destination and distinguish a destination that supplies no proof
contracts.boundary: Loopback Python peer; not arbitrary-topology or forged-proof acceptance.

contracts.title: Interface authentication: reject wrong IFAC credentials and continue serving after malformed or disconnected peers
contracts.boundary: Configured local software interfaces; not every interface or physical radio.

contracts.title: Reliable bulk data: send and fetch a multi-megabyte file between separately launched authenticated CLI processes
contracts.boundary: Bounded multi-megabyte local transfer; not the advertised multi-gigabyte scale.
